name: Pass 29 physical evidence-file bundle validation
goal: Ensure production handoff ledger evidence names resolve to actual files in the handoff bundle.
risks: Work ledger evidence could name files that were not provided
Evidence files could omit the production handoff or outage drill IDs they are supposed to prove
Runbook replay evidence could remain an unmaterialized string

nodes.label: Pass 29 physical evidence critic review

node_contract.what: Review whether production handoff bundle evidence proves physical artifact files.
node_contract.why: The original transcript asks for process evidence and handoff docs, not just file names.
node_contract.how: Inspect validator, ledger records, fixtures, and hardening runner for evidence-file checks.
node_contract.where: df-production-sre-handoff validator and DFMS hardening runner.
node_contract.who: Codex using traceability, governance, and verification expert lenses.
node_contract.how_good: Every new evidence-file bypass becomes executable validation or an explicit residual risk.

nodes.feedback_loop: Any unproven evidence-file reference becomes validator logic and a runner fixture.

nodes.label: Evidence-file bundle validator implementation

node_contract.what: Require production handoffs to validate against actual evidence files named by the ledger.
node_contract.why: File-like ledger evidence must resolve to physical files in the project book or validation bundle.
node_contract.how: Add --evidence-file arguments, compare ledger evidence basenames, check key ID mentions, and add regression checks.
node_contract.where: Installed and workspace df-production-sre-handoff validators plus runner.
node_contract.when: After critic review and before verification closure.
node_contract.how_good: Complete evidence bundle passes; missing or drifted evidence files fail.

nodes.feedback_loop: Rerun the full hardening suite after every evidence-file validation change.
gates: missing and drifted evidence-file fixtures reject

nodes.label: Pass 29 verification sweep

node_contract.why: Physical evidence-file hardening only counts if the full suite and merged records pass.
node_contract.how: Run hardening suite, merged-record validation, hash sync, JSON, ASCII, and artifact ID checks.
node_contract.where: Workspace validation suite and pass 29 records.
node_contract.when: After all fixes and records are written.
node_contract.how_good: All checks pass and residual risks remain explicit.

nodes.feedback_loop: Any failed check reopens the fix node.
